root_cause.text: In `irdma_create_qp`, the `free_qp` completion is initialized after the point where a failure in `ib_copy_to_udata` triggers `irdma_destroy_qp`, which attempts to wait on the uninitialized completion, leading to a use-before-init condition.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `init_completion(&iwqp->free_qp)` from after the `if (udata)` block (where `ib_copy_to_udata` is called) to before that block, so the completion is initialized before any potential error path that uses it. The CVE description explicitly states: "if ib_copy_to_udata fails, it will call irdma_destroy_qp to clean up which will attempt to wait on the free_qp completion, which is not initialized yet."
